note: Attribute definitions of the Architecture Metamodel: the fields every instance carries (core_fields) and each entity type's own attributes. Source, reasoning, verification and confidence per attribute. Not yet enforced by sdem-graph check (next build); export-conventions.json keys must all appear here (test).
confidence_rule: high = the attribute is defined by a public standard; medium = it encodes a standard concept or relationship as SDEM chose to record it, or is institution data under an SDEM convention; low = an SDEM field with no standard concept

core_fields.name: id
core_fields.description: the instance's permanent key — the source tool's own persistent id
core_fields.reasoning: Every relationship points at it; it must be unique in its level and never reused (knowledge-graph spec KG-I-01).

core_fields.name: type
core_fields.description: an entity type from the catalogue
core_fields.reasoning: Ties the instance to the Architecture Metamodel; must be concrete and of the export's level.

core_fields.name: version
core_fields.reasoning: Relationship ends pin it, so an approved relationship refers to a known state.

core_fields.name: name
core_fields.reasoning: Shown in traces; a rename changes the name, never the id.

core_fields.name: lifecycle_status
core_fields.reasoning: Lets retired things stay referable and planned (design) things be marked as such in traces.

core_fields.name: canonical_id
core_fields.description: external reference id, e.g. a BIAN concept id on A2 instances
core_fields.reasoning: BIAN-authority relationships require it on the A2 end before approval.

core_fields.name: description
core_fields.reasoning: Read by the step-5 text rule for capabilities and domains.

core_fields.name: definition_uri
core_fields.reasoning: Points to the institution's or the standard's definition.

core_fields.name: attributes
core_fields.description: the entity type's own attributes (this document)
core_fields.reasoning: Container for the per-type attributes below.

attributes.name: invokes
attributes.description: A2 operations the process steps call
attributes.verification: underlying relationship confirmed by the Archi oracle; holding it as an attribute is SDEM design
attributes.reasoning: Records on the process which BIAN operations it uses, so the A1→A2 USES_DOMAIN relationship can be derived by join instead of guessed. ArchiMate expresses this as behaviour served by a service; listing the operation ids on the process is SDEM's encoding.

attributes.name: invokes
attributes.description: A2 operations the activity calls
attributes.verification: underlying relationship confirmed by the Archi oracle; holding it as an attribute is SDEM design
attributes.reasoning: As for the process, at the level where one step calls one operation; makes S06 a step-1 join.

attributes.name: stages
attributes.description: ordered ids of the stream's stages
attributes.verification: underlying relationship confirmed by the Archi oracle; holding it as an attribute is SDEM design
attributes.reasoning: ArchiMate composes a value stream of stages; SDEM keeps them as an ordered list because stage order is what is matched to a BIAN scenario's operation sequence.

attributes.name: inputs
attributes.description: attribute names the service takes
attributes.verification: SDEM design; exercised by the use-case runs
attributes.reasoning: ArchiMate defines no attributes for a business service. SDEM adds inputs and outputs so a business service can be matched to BIAN operation inputs and outputs (S09). No standard defines them.

attributes.name: outputs
attributes.description: attribute names the service returns
attributes.verification: SDEM design; exercised by the use-case runs
attributes.reasoning: As for inputs.

attributes.name: attributes
attributes.description: glossary attribute names
attributes.verification: SDEM design; exercised by the use-case runs
attributes.reasoning: ArchiMate's business object has no attributes. SDEM records the bank's glossary attributes so the object can be aligned to a BIAN business object by attribute match (S12). Built on a standard concept; the field list is SDEM's.

attributes.name: field_aliases
attributes.description: glossary name → canonical attribute name
attributes.verification: values supplied by the institution; convention is SDEM design
attributes.reasoning: The bank's decoded names, supplied as data so matching never guesses (the H2 finding).

attributes.name: applies_to
attributes.description: ids of the processes or activities the requirement constrains
attributes.verification: underlying relationship confirmed by the Archi oracle; holding it as an attribute is SDEM design
attributes.reasoning: ArchiMate links a requirement to the core element that realizes it; SDEM records the targets on the requirement for joining.

attributes.name: owner
attributes.description: accountable owner
attributes.verification: SDEM design; exercised by the use-case runs
attributes.reasoning: Informational field used by one example; no rule reads it. Kept so exports that carry it validate.

attributes.name: asset_type
attributes.description: id of the domain's asset type
attributes.verification: BIAN public material; licensed release pending
attributes.reasoning: BIAN defines each Service Domain by the asset it manages; the field names it.

attributes.name: functional_pattern
attributes.description: id of the domain's functional pattern
attributes.verification: BIAN public material; licensed release pending
attributes.reasoning: BIAN defines each Service Domain by the pattern it applies; the field names it.

attributes.name: aliases
attributes.description: tokens the estate uses for the asset
attributes.verification: values supplied by the institution; convention is SDEM design
attributes.reasoning: The institution's decoded names for the asset, supplied as data; the token gate reads them (H1, H2 findings).
attributes.read_by: the step-2 boundary gate, S17, S19

attributes.name: attributes
attributes.description: the control record's attribute names
attributes.verification: BIAN public material; licensed release pending
attributes.reasoning: BIAN defines the control record and its attributes, rationalised with the Business Object Model in release 14.

attributes.name: lifecycle_states
attributes.description: ordered lifecycle states
attributes.verification: SDEM design; exercised by the use-case runs
attributes.reasoning: BIAN describes a control record as tracking an asset through its lifecycle but publishes no state list; SDEM records one so functions can be related to the states they act on.

attributes.name: action_term
attributes.description: one of BIAN's 17 action terms

reference.standard: BIAN Semantic API Practitioner Guide v8.1

attributes.verification: BIAN public material; licensed release pending
attributes.reasoning: BIAN names every operation by an action term; the term determines the REST method.

attributes.name: behavior_qualifier
attributes.description: qualifier name, or null

reference.standard: BIAN Semantic API Practitioner Guide v8.1

attributes.verification: BIAN public material; licensed release pending
attributes.reasoning: BIAN qualifies an operation by the control-record partition it acts on; the qualifier appears in the REST path. Null when the operation acts on the whole record.

attributes.name: input_attributes
attributes.description: control-record attributes the operation takes

reference.standard: BIAN Semantic API Practitioner Guide v8.1

attributes.verification: BIAN public material; licensed release pending
attributes.reasoning: BIAN derives an operation's request from the control record's attributes; SDEM lists their names.

attributes.name: output_attributes
attributes.description: control-record attributes the operation returns

reference.standard: BIAN Semantic API Practitioner Guide v8.1

attributes.verification: BIAN public material; licensed release pending
attributes.reasoning: As for inputs, for the response.

attributes.name: aliases
attributes.description: tokens the estate's API paths use for the qualifier
attributes.verification: values supplied by the institution; convention is SDEM design
attributes.reasoning: Decoded names supplied as data (H2 finding).

attributes.name: operation_sequence
attributes.description: ordered ids of the operations the scenario sequences
attributes.verification: BIAN public material; licensed release pending
attributes.reasoning: BIAN publishes scenarios as sequences of operations across domains.

attributes.name: attributes
attributes.description: the canonical object's attribute names
attributes.verification: BIAN public material; licensed release pending
attributes.reasoning: BIAN's BOM defines each object's attributes.

attributes.name: method
attributes.description: HTTP method, or BATCH / MQ / FILE for non-HTTP

reference.locator: Path Item Object (operation per HTTP method)

attributes.verification: public specification
attributes.reasoning: OpenAPI keys each operation by its HTTP method; BIAN maps action terms to methods (Practitioner Guide §3.5). Non-HTTP values are SDEM's, so step 2 can mark them not applicable (H1).

attributes.name: path
attributes.description: resource path
attributes.verification: public specification
attributes.reasoning: OpenAPI's path; BIAN places the qualifier in it.

attributes.name: payload_fields
attributes.description: request and response field names
attributes.verification: public specification
attributes.reasoning: OpenAPI describes payloads as schemas; SDEM flattens them to field names, which is enough to match against BIAN attributes but loses structure.

attributes.name: deployed_on
attributes.description: ids of the A4 platforms that host it

reference.locator: assignment (node assigned to deployed artifact), ch. 10

attributes.verification: underlying relationship confirmed by the Archi oracle; holding it as an attribute is SDEM design
attributes.reasoning: The join key for DEPLOYED_ON. ArchiMate expresses hosting as a node assigned to the deployed artifact; SDEM records the platform on the component.

attributes.name: deployed_as
attributes.description: ids of its A4 deployments
attributes.verification: SDEM design; exercised by the use-case runs
attributes.reasoning: The join key for DEPLOYED_AS, pointing at SDEM's Deployment entity.

attributes.name: built_as
attributes.description: ids of the A4 artifacts it is built as
attributes.verification: underlying relationship confirmed by the Archi oracle; holding it as an attribute is SDEM design
attributes.reasoning: ArchiMate: an artifact realizes an application component; SDEM records the artifacts on the component.

attributes.name: network_zone
attributes.description: id of the A4 network it sits in
attributes.verification: SDEM design; exercised by the use-case runs
attributes.reasoning: No standard field; SDEM's convenience key for S37. A network's connects list is the alternative; the zone wins when they disagree (C3 finding).

attributes.name: vendor
attributes.description: supplier name
attributes.verification: SDEM design; exercised by the use-case runs
attributes.reasoning: Informational field used by examples; no rule reads it.

attributes.name: accesses
attributes.description: data entities it accesses
attributes.verification: SDEM design; exercised by the use-case runs
attributes.reasoning: Duplicates the within-level access relationship already in the export; one example carries it. Deprecated: use the relationship.

attributes.name: consumes
attributes.description: ids of A4 technology services it uses
attributes.verification: underlying relationship confirmed by the Archi oracle; holding it as an attribute is SDEM design
attributes.reasoning: ArchiMate: a technology service serves the application layer; SDEM records the services on the application service.

attributes.name: exposed_through
attributes.description: ids of A4 technology interfaces it is exposed through
attributes.verification: underlying relationship confirmed by the Archi oracle; holding it as an attribute is SDEM design
attributes.reasoning: Records the gateway or listener the interface is reached through.

attributes.name: field_aliases
attributes.description: product field name → canonical attribute name
attributes.verification: values supplied by the institution; convention is SDEM design
attributes.reasoning: Decoded product names supplied as data; raised H2 recall from 0.78 to 1.00.

attributes.name: exposed_through
attributes.description: ids of the API operations the function is reached through
attributes.verification: SDEM design; exercised by the use-case runs
attributes.reasoning: No standard field; lets functions be related to BIAN operations through the APIs they serve.

attributes.name: consumes
attributes.description: ids of A4 technology services it uses
attributes.verification: underlying relationship confirmed by the Archi oracle; holding it as an attribute is SDEM design
attributes.reasoning: As for application service consumes, at function grain.

attributes.name: attributes
attributes.description: column names
attributes.verification: SDEM design; exercised by the use-case runs
attributes.reasoning: ArchiMate's data object has no attributes; SDEM records columns so tables can be matched to BIAN control records and business objects. Built on a standard concept; the field list is SDEM's.

attributes.name: stored_in
attributes.description: ids of the A4 system software or artifact holding it
attributes.verification: underlying relationship confirmed by the Archi oracle; holding it as an attribute is SDEM design
attributes.reasoning: Records where the data lives: a database (system software) or an object store (artifact).

attributes.name: field_aliases
attributes.description: column name → canonical attribute name
attributes.verification: values supplied by the institution; convention is SDEM design
attributes.reasoning: Overrides the aliases inherited from the interfaces of components that access the entity.

attributes.name: published_to
attributes.description: ids of A4 technology services (brokers) it is published to
attributes.verification: SDEM design; exercised by the use-case runs
attributes.reasoning: No adopted standard yet; corresponds to an AsyncAPI channel and to ArchiMate flow to a technology service.
attributes.read_by: S51; aligns with AsyncAPI channels (not adopted)

attributes.name: components
attributes.description: ids of the components the building block aggregates
attributes.verification: TOGAF login-gated; unverified
attributes.reasoning: TOGAF composes solution building blocks of solution components; the specification text could not be checked.

attributes.name: component_id
attributes.description: id of the A3 component deployed
attributes.verification: SDEM design; exercised by the use-case runs
attributes.reasoning: SDEM's Deployment makes ArchiMate's "artifact assigned to node" a record; these three fields name its parts.

attributes.name: environment_id
attributes.description: id of the environment
attributes.verification: SDEM design; exercised by the use-case runs
attributes.reasoning: As above.

attributes.name: platform_id
attributes.description: id of the A4 platform it runs on
attributes.verification: SDEM design; exercised by the use-case runs
attributes.reasoning: As above.

attributes.name: hosts
attributes.description: ids of A3 components it hosts
attributes.verification: underlying relationship confirmed by the Archi oracle; holding it as an attribute is SDEM design
attributes.reasoning: The platform-side view of deployed_on; either side is enough for the join.

attributes.name: hosts
attributes.description: ids of A3 components it hosts
attributes.verification: underlying relationship confirmed by the Archi oracle; holding it as an attribute is SDEM design
attributes.reasoning: As for Node.

attributes.name: hosts
attributes.description: ids of A3 components it hosts
attributes.verification: underlying relationship confirmed by the Archi oracle; holding it as an attribute is SDEM design
attributes.reasoning: As for Node.

attributes.name: connects
attributes.description: ids of nodes and devices on the network
attributes.verification: underlying relationship confirmed by the Archi oracle; holding it as an attribute is SDEM design
attributes.reasoning: ArchiMate associates nodes with networks.

attributes.name: from
attributes.description: id of one end
attributes.verification: underlying relationship confirmed by the Archi oracle; holding it as an attribute is SDEM design
attributes.reasoning: ArchiMate: a path connects two nodes.

attributes.name: to
attributes.description: id of the other end
attributes.verification: underlying relationship confirmed by the Archi oracle; holding it as an attribute is SDEM design
attributes.reasoning: As above.

attributes.name: network
attributes.description: id of the network realizing the path
attributes.verification: underlying relationship confirmed by the Archi oracle; holding it as an attribute is SDEM design
attributes.reasoning: ArchiMate: a communication network realizes a path.

attributes.name: carries
attributes.description: ids of A3 components whose traffic uses the path
attributes.verification: SDEM design; exercised by the use-case runs
attributes.reasoning: No standard field; SDEM's key for S38.

attributes.name: of_service
attributes.description: id of its technology service
attributes.verification: underlying relationship confirmed by the Archi oracle; holding it as an attribute is SDEM design
attributes.reasoning: ArchiMate: an interface is assigned to the service it exposes.

attributes.name: exposes
attributes.description: ids of A3 interfaces reachable through it
attributes.verification: SDEM design; exercised by the use-case runs
attributes.reasoning: Platform-side view of ApplicationInterface.exposed_through.

attributes.name: of_component
attributes.description: id of the A3 component it is a build of
attributes.verification: underlying relationship confirmed by the Archi oracle; holding it as an attribute is SDEM design
attributes.reasoning: Platform-side view of built_as.
